title: vanillostalgia
description: A client-side modpack built on the latest version; but captures the feeling of the golden days.
body:

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56c1206810a7363d6869e90f10355d149d306b0a.png)
_vanillostalgia_ is a modpack I created to be a lightweight vanilla modpack that plays and feels like a blend of old-school Minecraft and modern Minecraft. With worldgen and old features brought back, combined with new features with old textures, it'll feel just like when you were a kid playing the game for the first time. This modpack is very lightweight and works on servers, meaning you can enjoy the beauty of the past with your friends. Whether you're just looking for something fresh for your next playthrough, or miss the modern features of Minecraft when you play beta, there's something here for everyone to enjoy. 
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1ea7f2a49900d54319e78115d2befcca1be1d63.png)
This pack is built to work on any vanilla world and server, with some added flair:
- Lightweight and optimized modpack for a smooth experience.
- Built on the latest version of Minecraft available. 1.21.11 as of current.
- Highly-customizable beta worldgen with Moderner Beta, which can be configured on the Create New World screen.
- Old-school tweaks with new textures, C418 music only, old combat, and old fishing loot tables.
- Clientside additions with freecam, fullbright, bedrock bridging, inventory sorting, and Litematica.
- Serverside additions with fast leaf decay, vein mining, playerhead search, and craftable debug stick.
